items.title: These 4 Retail Stocks Are Winning the Race for Inflation-Weary Bargain Hunters
items.summary: Value and convenience are still top of mind for inflation-weary shoppers, writes a Bernstein analyst.

items.title: DLTR Falls 17.9% in the Past Month as Margin Risks Test Its Rebound
items.summary: Dollar Tree's sales and traffic gains support its rebound, but tariff-refund benefits and rising costs leave margin durability in focus.

items.title: DLTR Lifts 2026 Earnings Outlook as Tariff Refunds Fund Reinvestment
items.summary: Dollar Tree raises its fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS outlook after stronger Q2 execution and tariff refunds, while reinvesting heavily in pricing and stores.

items.title: Is DLTR a Buy as Earnings Improve but Margin and Tariff Risks Remain?
items.summary: Dollar Tree's stronger sales, traffic and earnings lift its outlook, but tariff volatility and reinvestment keep margins in focus.

items.title: Dollar General's Project Renovate and Elevate Drive Comp Sales Lift
items.summary: Dollar General's Renovate and Elevate remodels target stronger mature-store productivity, with annualized comp-sales lifts of about 6% and 3%.

items.title: Target Sees Underlying 2026 Margin Above 2025 as Profitability Improves
items.summary: Target expects the fiscal 2026 underlying operating margin to top 2025 by about 50 basis points as gross margin improves despite higher SG&A costs.

items.title: Buy 3 Big Discount Retailers to Gain From Solid Near-Term Price Upside
items.summary: ROST, DLTR and DG are backed by value-focused strategies, improving estimates and store initiatives that could support growth.

items.title: Non-Discretionary Retail Stocks Q2 Recap: Benchmarking Dollar General (NYSE:DG)
items.summary: As the craze of earnings season draws to a close, here’s a look back at some of the most exciting (and some less so) results from Q2. Today, we are looking at non-discretionary retail stocks, starting with Dollar General (NYSE:DG).
